name: Castellví de la Marca (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with the yellow open castle of the arms bearing four red pales.
history: The municipal council of Castellví de la Marca approved the flag on 13 December 2000; it was confirmed by the Generalitat on 30 January 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya. It is an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the yellow open castle with four red pales of the arms at the centre, 4/5 of the height and 13/30 of the length.

features.role: open castle with four red pales, 4/5 of the height
